content.text:
I could answer four of the six questions from governed data. The catalog doesn't model loss ratio or agent commission, so I can't answer questions 5 and 6.

**1. Net written premium by region, Q3 2026 (July–September)**

| Region | Net written premium |
|---|---|
| APAC | 278,969.21 |
| EMEA | 343,269.84 |
| LATAM | 308,624.73 |
| North America | 312,420.42 |

This is gross written premium minus cancellations, counted in the month the premium takes effect. Quotes are excluded.

**2. Gross written premium by product line, H1 2026 (January–June)**

| Product line | Gross written premium |
|---|---|
| Auto | 582,225.40 |
| Commercial | 1,453,678.56 |
| Home | 626,038.09 |

This is premium before cancellations, excluding taxes and fees, counted in the month it takes effect. Quotes are excluded.

**3. Policies written in March 2026:** 95. This counts distinct policies with premium taking effect in March. Quotes aren't counted as policies.

**4. Paid on closed claims in Q2 2026, by severity**

| Severity | Claims paid |
|---|---|
| High | 18,616.26 |
| Low | 13,530.45 |
| Medium | 17,904.82 |

This is the amount paid on closed claims, counted in the month each claim closed.

**5. Loss ratio by region, Q3 2026:** Can't be answered. The catalog states that it doesn't model loss ratio. Claims paid also can't be broken down by region: it only splits by severity and the month the claim closed.

**6. Agent commission paid, Q3 2026:** Can't be answered. No commission metric exists; the only metrics are claims paid, gross written premium, net written premium and policies written.

The data team owns the catalog and would need to add these metrics before questions 5 and 6 can be answered.
